title: Carve 0.2 bracket constructs
description: The forms built on a bracket pair. An opening bracket is pushed on the bracket stack, a closing bracket pairs with the nearest open one, and what is glued to the closing bracket decides the construct (C2-I-006). Sorted by name.

name.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

content.description: `inline`: read as inline content. `source`: kept as written, not parsed. `label`: a label, taken whole (C2-I-076).

host.description: True when an attribute block glued to the end attaches to it.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

closer.description: The closing character, where it is not the paired bracket of the stack.

prefix.description: A character glued before the opening bracket.

glued_after.description: What is glued to the closing bracket. `anything_else`: the pair forms no construct, is plain text and bounds nothing.

items.description: What is glued to the closing bracket. `anything_else`: the pair forms no construct, is plain text and bounds nothing.

content_min.description: The lowest count of content characters.

nests_in_itself.description: False when the form inside its own content is replaced by that content (C2-I-071).

unclosed.description: Without its closing bracket the opener is literal text.

file.description: The data file of this directory that defines the opener.
